name: feature-flow
description: An end-to-end feature workflow as a single plugin: brainstorm options on a page you answer in place, write a medium-weight spec reviewed on a page of key points, pictures and question cards, audit umbrellas for coherence, implement the spec (solo, via a team of agents, or as a scripted dynamic workflow), then document what shipped — plus a read-only bug investigation that finds the root cause before offering fixes. Six sibling skills (feature-brainstorm, feature-spec, feature-spec-audit, feature-implement, doc-generator, bug-investigate) that share conventions and reference assets — install once, get the whole flow.
